results.rationale: Consistency: white setting remains, but shell/face details and foreleg poses are redrawn on both turtles, including the small one. Instruction: the left turtle remains much larger than the right and is not reduced to match. Quality: coherent shells, heads and scaled limbs with natural contact shadows and no conspicuous artifacts.

Consistency: square black/white diamond cushion identity persists, but the arrangement and scale of diamonds on its face visibly change. Instruction: prominent close-up cushion on a charcoal sofa, cool minimal interior and bold top-left title are present; the odd double-quote apostrophe in Life’s is a small text defect. Quality: coherent fabric and sofa perspective, with a minor typographic punctuation artifact.
